requirements_summary:
- Workload: lightweight in-app chat assistant embedded in product UI (web + mobile)
- Mode: streaming responses required (token-by-token) for perceived responsiveness
- Latency target: p95 message start < 200ms, end-to-end response < 700ms for 40 concurrent users
- Throughput: expected steady-state ~30-60 requests/minute during spikes; small bursts up to 150 requests/minute
- Cost sensitivity: high for early stage — looking for cost per active user <= $0.10/month (initial goal)
- Model preferences: open/quantized models if quality acceptable; comfortable with Redwood-curated smaller variants and autoscaling; wants easy switch to higher-quality model for paid tiers
- Routing/fallback: single-region (us-west) preferred, automatic fallback to quantized variant when latency spikes or budget limit reached
- Data & security: SOC2 required, SSO for admin console, audit logs for token activity, 30-day retention by default, US-only residency for PII
